prompt: Which setup addresses the problem the woman noticed?
promptZh: 哪種擺法能解決女方發現的問題？

options.text: Set the samples directly on the table.
options.zh: 把樣本道具直接擺在桌面上。
options.whyZh: 她發現一拉桌布就會滑；男方改用裸桌面，去除會滑動的桌布。

options.text: Use a shorter table with the same cloth.
options.zh: 換一張較短的桌子，仍鋪原來的桌布。
options.whyZh: 縮短桌子不會拿掉會滑動的桌布。

options.text: Put every sample on one end of the cloth.
options.zh: 把所有樣本道具都放在桌布的一端。
options.whyZh: 仍有會滑動的桌布，集中擺放也與道具要分開的安排相反。

options.text: Swap the wooden wheel for a heavier one.
options.whyZh: 問題出在桌布，不是木輪的重量。

explanationZh: 她發現一拉桌布就會滑；男方改用裸桌面，去除會滑動的桌布。

evidence.speaker: F
evidence.exactQuote: Bring the copy. Leave off the cloth. It slides when pulled.

evidence.speaker: M
evidence.exactQuote: Right. I’ll set the props directly on the table, spaced apart so people can feel one at a time.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The press team lent us this gap gauge until the end of our shift. I checked the first tray. The one with the green clip still needs checking.
